The investigation traced twenty distinct blockchain entities linked to the seed wallet 0xfc560e2e03603e6ec608bafe2de1f2f636221c44, involving twenty‑three transfers across a maximum depth of three hops. Nineteen transfers were confirmed and four additional correlations were inferred. The movement pattern shows a high‑risk profile (score 60/100) for the seed wallet, driven by proximity to a known scam cluster, interaction with a mixer contract (transfer of 700 USDT to 0x8c27921fa4ae2dccf2d40e426bad900b4f037da2), exposure to a cross‑chain bridge within two downstream hops, and fan‑out dispersal to six separate downstream addresses. Nineteen of the transfers meet or exceed the 30 % reporting threshold, while four fall below it.

The highest‑scoring entities are the seed wallet (60/100, HIGH) and two downstream addresses—0x8c27921fa4ae2dccf2d40e426bad900b4f037da2 and 0xa48646da1dc281e33a31a816acaea0f5f41b2d72—each scoring 35/100 (MEDIUM). The fund flow demonstrates multiple layers of redistribution, mixer usage, and bridge interaction, indicating a structured attempt to obscure the origin and ultimate destination of the reported loss of INR 12,17,000.
